title: Feeling ill at work
instructions: Bir çalışan yöneticisine hasta olduğunu söylüyor. Belirtiler ve karara dikkat et.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Excuse me, Linda. I don't feel very well.

script.speaker: a
script.text: I have a terrible headache, and I think I have a temperature.

script.speaker: b
script.text: You should go home and rest.

script.speaker: a
script.text: But I have the report to finish for tomorrow.

script.speaker: b
script.text: Don't worry about that. Maria can finish it. Just send her your notes.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Thank you. I'll email them now.

script.speaker: b
script.text: And call me tomorrow morning if you can't come in.
